input: Organize a potluck dinner for my book club

gold.taskTitle: Organize a Book Club Potluck Dinner
gold.taskDescription: Plan and coordinate a potluck dinner event for the user's book club group.

questions.title: How many people are in your book club?
questions.description: Understand the group size to plan portions, space, and coordination needs.

questions.title: When do you want the potluck to take place?
questions.description: Identify the target date or timeframe to set a planning deadline.

questions.title: Where will the dinner be hosted?
questions.description: Determine the venue, whether someone's home, a rented space, or elsewhere.

questions.title: Is there a theme tied to your current book?
questions.description: Find out if the food should connect to the book being discussed.

questions.title: How will you assign dishes to members?
questions.description: Clarify whether dishes are assigned by category, first-come, or left open.

questions.title: Are there dietary restrictions you need to accommodate?
questions.description: Identify allergies, preferences, or dietary needs among group members.

questions.title: What tool will you use to communicate with members?
questions.description: Know whether coordination happens via group chat, email, a signup app, etc.
